newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Three die, dozens hurt in Manila jail riot.
newsitem.headline: Three die, dozens hurt in Manila jail riot.

text.p: At least three prisoners were killed and dozens wounded on Tuesday when gangs armed with fire bombs, knives and darts battled each other in Manila's city jail, police said.
Police commando teams exploded tear gas canisters and firemen bombarded the rioters with water to quell the disturbance after two hours.
It was the fourth riot in nine months in the jail, each time started by fighting between rival gangs.
Fire gutted one cell and a wounded woman visitor scrambled out of the compound, screaming, "Pity me, pity me."

Jail guards barred media from the jail at the height of the rioting, prompting one radio reporter to shout over the air: "We can't get in, we can't get in... It's easy for drug pushers to get in but media can't get in." About 2,600 prisoners are crammed inside the central jail but it was not immediately clear how many were involved in the disturbance, a police sergeant told Reuters.
